_comment: L-doc fields a checker reads that NO real document populates (vibe-ic#312 family). MAY ONLY SHRINK — each entry is a consumer reading what nobody writes, so every PASS on that path is an empty result wearing a clean one's clothes. ADJUDICATION BASIS: this register is corpus-relative and is recorded against the PUBLISHED corpus (vibeic/benchmark-data origin/main — the tree every corpus-bound landing points VIBE_IC_BENCHMARK_DATA at). The 2026-08-31 growth 3 -> 8 is NOT five fields losing their producers; it is the register catching up to that canonical basis — the five were findings against the published corpus all along (measured at corpus e03ccabf: each present-and-empty in the 2 published spm L19/L21 docs, populated in 0 of 24 L-docs) while the register had been written against a richer local corpus that hid them. `triage` records what was actually found per entry, including entries proven to be FALSE POSITIVES of this gate's own rule: removing those by inventing a producer would be the worst possible repair.

triage.die_area_budget_um: CONFIRMED reader-without-producer, but NOT the empty-equals-clean shape: every consumer already distinguishes absent LOUDLY. `area_total_vs_budget_check` answers INCOMPLETE naming `L19.die_area_budget_um` as the missing ceiling; `l19_pdk_floorplan_contract_check._l19_die` / `l9_floorplan_contract_check` treat a null as 'no declaration' and their cross-layer clauses only fire on a non-null value; phase3 auto-sizes and discloses. The value is a USER contract term (a fixed die the design mandates) — a producer must never derive one, so the paydown is deterministic extraction of a budget the design's own inputs STATE (the #451 pdk_target shape, with its trusted-span guards), populated on the first published cell whose spec states one.
triage.floorplan_hints: FALSE-POSITIVE-ADJACENT: the sole reader is `l19_pdk_floorplan_contract_check` L19-4, an ADVISORY-ONLY reporter whose own doctrine says gating on this field would re-create the token-presence shape the gate exists to replace. No consumer demands it, so its emptiness certifies nothing and misleads nobody. Kept recorded because the rule fired correctly by its own definition (a reader exists); the honest paydown is a consumer that actually uses hints, or retiring the key — never fabricating hints.
triage.isolation_cells: CONFIRMED. Sole basis for a verdict on the L21 fallback path of power_domain_signal_crossing_check: an empty set was read as 'no strategy scopes this domain' and every protected crossing was reported UNPROTECTED (ERROR) — a false FAIL. Mitigated in v1.6.16 (PROTECTION_UNSTATED); the missing producer itself is still open.
triage.level_shifters: CONFIRMED. Same path and same false-FAIL direction as isolation_cells; same v1.6.16 mitigation.
triage.power_budget_uw: CONFIRMED reader-without-producer with a REAL consumer: `power_total_vs_budget_check` reads it via `_ppa/power.resolve_power_requirement` as the L19 fallback authority — and that consumer already REFUSES loudly (INCOMPLETE naming the absent limit) rather than passing on empty, and refuses by doctrine to invent a threshold from die area or supply voltage. NOTE: L19-4's advisory text 'no program in the flow reads it' predates that consumer and is stale. The value is a USER contract term; paydown is deterministic extraction of a budget the design's own inputs STATE (unit-converted to uW), populated on the first published cell whose spec states one.
triage.power_domains: FALSE POSITIVE of this gate's rule — do NOT 'fix' it by inventing a producer. TWO producers already exist and are wired: `l21_macro_supply_rail_synth` (v1.8.79/v1.8.95, from the design's own macro LEFs) and `l21_doc_supply_rail_synth` (from the design's own document supply tables). The published corpus cells are macro-less digital designs staging no supply table, so [] is the TRUE value, and the consumers distinguish it loudly: `l21_macro_supply_rail_declared_check` SKIPs (rc 2) with no macro LEF and FAILs (undeclared rail) on macros + empty; power_domain_signal_crossing_check answers PROTECTION_UNSTATED. Empty is neither silent nor indistinguishable from clean anywhere it is read.
triage.sdc_constraints_path: PRODUCER FIXED in the commit that recorded this entry: `phase1_post_process.emit_l_doc_skeleton` now populates it from the design's OWN staged SDC (`sdc_constraints.collect_sdc_files` priority order — input/constraints/ first — the same list phase3 synth consumes), project-relative, existing-at-emit-time by construction, honest null when the design stages none. The published corpus docs predate the fix, so the entry stands until the first post-fix cell publishes a populated value — at which point this gate's paid-debt direction forces the entry out.
triage.tables: FALSE POSITIVE of this gate's rule — do NOT 'fix' it by inventing a producer. l15_encoding_tables_contract_check reads it only in the WARN tier as `content = n_declared + len(tables)`, where the second term comes from iter_tables() walking the whole fields subtree. It is a SUPPLEMENT, not the sole basis for a verdict, so its absence contributes zero rather than producing an empty-equals-clean ambiguity. Kept in the register because the rule did fire correctly by its own definition, and because deleting the entry would erase this finding.
